verses.english: Day and night woman must be kept in dependence by the males (of) their (families), and, if they attach themselves to sensual enjoyments, they must be kept under one's control.

verses.text:
पिता रक्षति कौमारे भर्ता रक्षति यौवने ।
रक्षन्ति स्थविरे पुत्रा न स्त्री स्वातन्त्र्यम् अर्हति ॥ ३
                                    ॥
verses.english: Her father protects (her) in childhood, her husband protects (her) in youth, and her sons protect (her) in old age; a woman is never fit for independence.

verses.text:
काले ऽ.दाता पिता वाच्यो वाच्यश् च-अन्.उपयन् पतिः ।
मृते भर्तरि पुत्रस् तु वाच्यो मातुर् अरक्षिता ॥ ४ ॥
verses.english: Reprehensible is the father who gives not (his daughter in marriage) at the proper time; reprehensible is the husband who approaches not (his wife in due season), and reprehensible is the son who does not protect his mother after her husband has died.

verses.text:
सूक्ष्मेभ्यो ऽपि प्रसङ्गेभ्यः स्त्रियो रक्ष्या विशेषतः ।
                                        ९.०५अव्/
                                        म्: स्त्रिया
द्वयोर् हि कुलयोः शोकम् आवहेयुर् अ.रक्षिताः ॥ ५ ॥
verses.english: Women must particularly be guarded against evil inclinations, however trifling (they may appear); for, if they are not guarded, they will bring sorrow on two families.

verses.text:
इमं हि सर्ववर्णानां पश्यन्तो धर्मम् उत्तमम् ।
यतन्ते रक्षितुं भार्यां भर्तारो दुर्बला अपि ॥ ६ ॥
verses.english: Considering that the highest duty of all castes, even weak husbands (must) strive to guard their wives.

verses.text:
स्वां प्रसूतिं चरित्रं च कुलम् आत्मानम् एव च ।
स्वं च धर्मं प्रयत्नेन जायां रक्षन् हि रक्षति ॥ ७
                                    ॥
verses.english: He who carefully guards his wife, preserves (the purity of) his offspring, virtuous conduct, his family, himself, and his (means of acquiring) merit.

verses.text:
पतिर् भार्यां सम्प्रविश्य गर्भो भूत्वा-इह जायते ।
जायायास् तद्द् हि जायात्वं यद् अस्यां जायते पुनः ॥ ८
                                    ॥
verses.english: The husband, after conception by his wife, becomes an embryo and is born again of her; for that is the wifehood of a wife (gaya), that he is born (gayate) again by her.

verses.text:
यादृशं भजते हि स्त्री सुतं सूते तथाविधम् ।
तस्मात् प्रजाविशुद्धि.अर्थं स्त्रियं रक्षेत् प्रयत्नतः ॥
                                    ९ ॥
verses.english: As the male is to whom a wife cleaves, even so is the son whom she brings forth; let him therefore carefully guard his wife, in order to keep his offspring pure.

verses.text:
न कश् चिद् योषितः शक्तः प्रसह्य परिरक्षितुम् ।
एतैर् उपाययोगैस् तु शक्यास् ताः परिरक्षितुम् ॥ १० ॥
verses.english: No man can completely guard women by force; but they can be guarded by the employment of the (following) expedients:

verses.text:
अर्थस्य सङ्ग्रहे च-एनां व्यये च-एव नियोजयेत् ।
शौचे धर्मे ऽन्नपक्त्यां च पारिणाह्यस्य वेक्षणे ॥ ११
                                    ॥
verses.english: Let the (husband) employ his (wife) in the collection and expenditure of his wealth, in keeping (everything) clean, in (the fulfilment of) religious duties, in the preparation of his food, and in looking after the household utensils.

verses.text:
अ.रक्षिता गृहे रुद्धाः पुरुषैर् आप्तकारिभिः ।
आत्मानम् आत्मना यास् तु रक्षेयुस् ताः सुरक्षिताः ॥ १२
                                    ॥
verses.english: Women, confined in the house under trustworthy and obedient servants, are not (well) guarded; but those who of their own accord keep guard over themselves, are well guarded.

verses.text:
पानं दुर्जनसंसर्गः पत्या च विरहो ऽटनम् ।
स्वप्नो ऽन्यगेहवासश् च नारीसन्दूषणानि षट् ॥ १३ ॥
verses.english: Drinking (spirituous liquor), associating with wicked people, separation from the husband, rambling abroad, sleeping (at unseasonable hours), and dwelling in other men's houses, are the six causes of the ruin of women.

verses.text:
न-एता रूपं परीक्षन्ते न-आसां वयसि संस्थितिः ।
सुरूपं वा विरूपं वा पुमान् इत्य् एव भुञ्जते ॥ १४ ॥
verses.english: Women do not care for beauty, nor is their attention fixed on age; (thinking), '(It is enough that) he is a man,' they give themselves to the handsome and to the ugly.

verses.text:
पौंश्चल्याच् चलचित्ताच् च नैस्नेह्याच् च स्वभावतः ।
                                        ९.१५अव्/
                                        म्: नैःस्नेह्याच्
रक्षिता यत्नतो ऽपि-इह भर्तृष्व् एता विकुर्वते ॥ १५
                                    ॥
verses.english: Through their passion for men, through their mutable temper, through their natural heartlessness, they become disloyal towards their husbands, however carefully they may be guarded in this (world).

verses.text:
एवं स्वभावं ज्ञात्वा-आसां प्रजापतिनिसर्गजम् ।
परमं यत्नम् आतिष्ठेत् पुरुषो रक्षणं प्रति ॥ १६
                                    ॥
verses.english: Knowing their disposition, which the Lord of creatures laid in them at the creation, to be such, (every) man should most strenuously exert himself to guard them.

verses.text:
शय्या.आसनम् अलङ्कारं कामं क्रोधम् अनार्जवम् । ९.१७अव्/ म्: 
                                        अनार्यताम्
द्रोहभावं कुचर्यां च स्त्रीभ्यो मनुर् अकल्पयत् ॥ १७ ॥
                                        ९.१७च्व्/
                                        म्: द्रोग्धृभावं ॥ 9.17 ॥
verses.english: (When creating them) Manu allotted to women (a love of their) bed, (of their) seat and (of) ornament, impure desires, wrath, dishonesty, malice, and bad conduct.

verses.text:
न-अस्ति स्त्रीणां क्रिया मन्त्रैर् इति धर्मे
                                    व्यवस्थितिः
निर्.इन्द्रिया ह्य् अ.मन्त्राश् च स्त्रीभ्यो ऽनृतम् इति स्थितिः
                                    ॥ १८ ॥ ९.१८च्व्/ म्: स्त्रियो ॥ 9.18 ॥
verses.english: For women no (sacramental) rite (is performed) with sacred texts, thus the law is settled; women (who are) destitute of strength and destitute of (the knowledge of) Vedic texts, (are as impure as) falsehood (itself), that is a fixed rule.

verses.text:
तथा च श्रुतयो बह्व्यो निगीता निगमेष्व् अपि ।
स्वालक्षण्यपरीक्षार्थं तासां शृणुत निष्कृतीः ॥ १९
                                    ॥
verses.english: And to this effect many sacred texts are sung also in the Vedas, in order to (make) fully known the true disposition (of women); hear (now those texts which refer to) the expiation of their (sins).

verses.text:
यन् मे माता प्रलुलुभे विचरन्त्य् अ.पतिव्रता ।
तन् मे रेतः पिता वृङ्क्ताम् इत्य् अस्य-एतन् निदर्शनम् ॥ २०
                                    ॥
verses.english: 'If my mother, going astray and unfaithful, conceived illicit desires, may my father keep that seed from me,' that is the scriptural text.

verses.text:
ध्यायत्य् अनिष्टं यत् किं चित् पाणिग्राहस्य चेतसा ।
तस्य-एष व्यभिचारस्य निह्नवः सम्यग् उच्यते ॥ २१
                                    ॥
verses.english: If a woman thinks in her heart of anything that would pain her husband, the (above-mentioned text) is declared (to be a means for) completely removing such infidelity.

verses.text:
यादृग्.गुणेन भर्त्रा स्त्री संयुज्येत यथाविधि ।
तादृग्.गुणा सा भवति समुद्रेण-इव निम्नगा ॥ २२ ॥
verses.english: Whatever be the qualities of the man with whom a woman is united according to the law, such qualities even she assumes, like a river (united) with the ocean.

verses.text:
अक्षमाला वसिष्ठेन संयुक्ता-अधमयोनिजा ।
शारङ्गी मन्दपालेन जगाम-अभ्यर्हणीयताम् ॥ २३ ॥
verses.english: Akshamala, a woman of the lowest birth, being united to Vasishtha and Sarangi, (being united) to Mandapala, became worthy of honour.

verses.text:
एताश् च-अन्याश् च लोके ऽस्मिन्न् अपकृष्टप्रसूतयः । ९.२४अव्/ म्: 
                                        अवकृष्टप्रसूतयः
उत्कर्षं योषितः प्राप्ताः स्वैः स्वैर् भर्तृगुणैः शुभैः
                                    ॥ २४ ॥
verses.english: These and other females of low birth have attained eminence in this world by the respective good qualities of their husbands.

verses.text:
एषा-उदिता लोकयात्रा नित्यं स्त्री.पुंसयोः शुभा ।
प्रेत्य-इह च सुख.उदर्कान् प्रजाधर्मान् निबोधत ॥ २५
                                    ॥
verses.english: Thus has been declared the ever pure popular usage (which regulates the relations) between husband and wife; hear (next) the laws concerning children which are the cause of happiness in this world and after death.

verses.text:
प्रजनार्थं महा.भागाः पूज.अर्हा गृहदीप्तयः ।
स्त्रियः श्रियश् च गेहेषु न विशेषो ऽस्ति कश् चन ॥ २६
                                    ॥
verses.english: Between wives (striyah) who (are destined) to bear children, who secure many blessings, who are worthy of worship and irradiate (their) dwellings, and between the goddesses of fortune (sriyah, who reside) in the houses (of men), there is no difference whatsoever.

verses.text:
उत्पादनम् अपत्यस्य जातस्य परिपालनम् ।
प्रत्यहं लोकयात्रायाः प्रत्यक्षं स्त्री निबन्धनम् ॥ २७
                                    ॥ ९.२७च्व्/
                                        म्: प्रत्यर्थं ॥ 9.27 ॥
verses.english: The production of children, the nurture of those born, and the daily life of men, (of these matters) woman is visibly the cause.

verses.text:
अपत्यं धर्मकार्याणि शुश्रूषा रतिर् उत्तमा ।
दारा.अधीनस् तथा स्वर्गः पितॄणाम् आत्मनश् च ह ॥ २८
                                    ॥
verses.english: Offspring, (the due performance on religious rites, faithful service, highest conjugal happiness and heavenly bliss for the ancestors and oneself, depend on one's wife alone.

verses.text:
पतिं या न-अभिचरति मनो.वाग्.देहसंयता ।
सा भर्तृलोकान् आप्नोति सद्भिः साध्वी-इति च-उच्यते ॥ २९
                                    ॥
verses.english: She who, controlling her thoughts, speech, and acts, violates not her duty towards her lord, dwells with him (after death) in heaven, and in this world is called by the virtuous a faithful (wife, sadhvi)

verses.text:
व्यभिचारात् तु भर्तुः स्त्री लोके प्राप्नोति निन्द्यताम् ।
सृगालयोनिं च-आप्नोति पापरोगैश् च पीड्यते ॥ ३० ॥
                                        ९.३०च्व्/
                                        म्: शृगालयोनिं ॥ 9.30 ॥
verses.english: But for disloyalty to her husband a wife is censured among men, and (in her next life) she is born in the womb of a jackal and tormented by diseases, the punishment of her sin.

verses.text:
पुत्रं प्रत्युदितं सद्भिः पूर्वजैश् च महर्षिभिः ।
विश्वजन्यम् इमं पुण्यम् उपन्यासं निबोधत ॥ ३१ ॥
verses.english: Listen (now) to the following holy discussion, salutary to all men, which the virtuous (of the present day) and the ancient great sages have held concerning male offspring.

verses.text:
भर्तरि पुत्रं विजानन्ति श्रुतिद्वैधं तु कर्तरि ।
                                        ९.३२अव्/
                                        म्: भर्तुः
आहुर् उत्पादकं के चिद् अपरे क्षेत्रिणं विदुः ॥ ३२ ॥
verses.english: They (all) say that the male issue (of a woman) belongs to the lord, but with respect to the (meaning of the term) lord the revealed texts differ; some call the begetter (of the child the lord), others declare (that it is) the owner of the soil.

verses.text:
क्षेत्रभूता स्मृता नारी बीजभूतः स्मृतः पुमान् ।
क्षेत्र.बीजसमायोगात् सम्भवः सर्वदेहिनाम् ॥ ३३ ॥
verses.english: By the sacred tradition the woman is declared to be the soil, the man is declared to be the seed; the production of all corporeal beings (takes place) through the union of the soil with the seed.

verses.text:
विशिष्टं कुत्र चिद् बीजं स्त्रीयोनिस् त्व् एव कुत्र चित् ।
उभयं तु समं यत्र सा प्रसूतिः प्रशस्यते ॥ ३४
                                    ॥
verses.english: In some cases the seed is more distinguished, and in some the womb of the female; but when both are equal, the offspring is most highly esteemed.

verses.text:
बीजस्य च-एव योन्याश् च बीजम् उत्कृष्टम् उच्यते ।
सर्वभूतप्रसूतिर् हि बीजलक्षणलक्षिता ॥ ३५ ॥
verses.english: On comparing the seed and the receptacle (of the seed), the seed is declared to be more important; for the offspring of all created beings is marked by the characteristics of the seed.

verses.text:
यादृशं तु-उप्यते बीजं क्षेत्रे काल.उपपादिते ।
तादृग् रोहति तत् तस्मिन् बीजं स्वैर् व्यञ्जितं गुणैः ॥
                                    ३६ ॥
verses.english: Whatever (kind on seed is sown in a field, prepared in due season, (a plant) of that same kind, marked with the peculiar qualities of the seed, springs up in it.

verses.text:
इयं भूमिर् हि भूतानां शाश्वती योनिर् उच्यते ।
न च योनिगुणान् कांश् चिद् बीजं पुष्यति पुष्टिषु ॥ ३७
                                    ॥
verses.english: This earth, indeed, is called the primeval womb of created beings; but the seed develops not in its development any properties of the womb.

verses.text:
भूमाव् अप्य् एककेदारे काल.उप्तानि कृषीवलैः ।
नानारूपाणि जायन्ते बीजानि-इह स्वभावतः ॥ ३८ ॥
verses.english: In this world seeds of different kinds, sown at the proper time in the land, even in one field, come forth (each) according to its kind.

verses.text:
व्रीहयः शालयो मुद्गास् तिला माषास् तथा यवाः ।
यथाबीजं प्ररोहन्ति लशुनानि-इक्षवस् तथा ॥ ३९ ॥
verses.english: The rice (called) vrihi and (that called) sali, mudga-beans, sesamum, masha-beans, barley, leeks, and sugar-cane, (all) spring up according to their seed.

verses.text:
अन्यद् उप्तं जातम् अन्यद् इत्य् एतत्-न-उपपद्यते ।
उप्यते यद्द् हि यद् बीजं तत् तद् एव प्ररोहति ॥ ४०
                                    ॥
verses.english: That one (plant) should be sown and another be produced cannot happen; whatever seed is sown, (a plant of) that kind even comes forth.

verses.text:
तत् प्राज्ञेन विनीतेन ज्ञान.विज्ञानवेदिना ।
आयुष्कामेन वप्तव्यं न जातु परयोषिति ॥ ४१ ॥
verses.english: Never therefore must a prudent well-trained man, who knows the Veda and its Angas and desires long life, cohabit with another's wife.

verses.text:
अत्र गाथा वायुगीताः कीर्तयन्ति पुराविदः ।
यथा बीजं न वप्तव्यं पुंसा परपरिग्रहे ॥ ४२ ॥
verses.english: With respect to this (matter), those acquainted with the past recite some stanzas, sung by Vayu (the Wind, to show) that seed must not be sown by (any) man on that which belongs to another.

verses.text:
नश्यति-इषुर् यथा विद्धः खे विद्धम् अनुविध्यतः ।
तथा नश्यति वै क्षिप्रं बीजं परपरिग्रहे ॥ ४३ ॥
                                        ९.४३च्व्/
                                        म्: क्षिप्तं ॥ 9.43 ॥
verses.english: As the arrow, shot by (a hunter) who afterwards hits a wounded (deer) in the wound (made by another), is shot in vain, even so the seed, sown on what belongs to another, is quickly lost (to the sower).

verses.text:
पृथोर् अपि-इमां पृथिवीं भार्यां पूर्वविदो विदुः ।
स्थाणु.च्छेदस्य केदारम् आहुः शाल्यवतो मृगम् ॥ ४४
                                    ॥
verses.english: (Sages) who know the past call this earth (prithivi) even the wife of Prithu; they declare a field to belong to him who cleared away the timber, and a deer to him who (first) wounded it.

verses.text:
एतावान् एव पुरुषो यत्-जाया-आत्मा प्रजा-इति ह ।
विप्राः प्राहुस् तथा च-एतद् यो भर्ता सा स्मृत.अङ्गना ॥
                                    ४५ ॥
verses.english: He only is a perfect man who consists (of three persons united), his wife, himself, and his offspring; thus (says the Veda), and (learned) Brahmanas propound this (maxim) likewise, 'The husband is declared to be one with the wife.'

verses.text:
न निष्क्रय.विसर्गाभ्यां भर्तुर् भार्या विमुच्यते ।
एवं धर्मं विजानीमः प्राक् प्रजापतिनिर्मितम् ॥ ४६
                                    ॥
verses.english: Neither by sale nor by repudiation is a wife released from her husband; such we know the law to be, which the Lord of creatures (Pragapati) made of old.

verses.text:
सकृद् अंशो निपतति सकृत् कन्या प्रदीयते ।
सकृद् आह ददानि-इति त्रीण्य् एतानि सतां सकृत् ॥ ४७ ॥
                                        ९.४७च्व्/
                                        म्: ददामि-इति ॥ 9.47 ॥
verses.english: Once is the partition (of the inheritance) made, (once is) a maiden given in marriage, (and) once does (a man) say,' I will give;' each of those three (acts is done) once only.

verses.text:
यथा गो.ऽश्व.उष्ट्र.दासीषु महिष्य्.अजा.अविकासु च ।
न-उत्पादकः प्रजाभागी तथा-एव-अन्याङ्गनास्व् अपि ॥ ४८
                                    ॥
verses.english: As with cows, mares, female camels, slave-girls, buffalo-cows, she-goats, and ewes, it is not the begetter (or his owner) who obtains the offspring, even thus (it is) with the wives of others.

verses.text:
ये ऽक्षेत्रिणो बीजवन्तः परक्षेत्रप्रवापिणः ।
ते वै सस्यस्य जातस्य न लभन्ते फलं क्व चित् ॥ ४९
                                    ॥
verses.english: Those who, having no property in a field, but possessing seed-corn, sow it in another's soil, do indeed not receive the grain of the crop which may spring up.

verses.text:
यद् अन्यगोषु वृषभो वत्सानां जनयेत्-शतम् ।
गोमिनाम् एव ते वत्सा मोघं स्कन्दितम् आर्षभम् ॥ ५०
                                    ॥
verses.english: If (one man's) bull were to beget a hundred calves on another man's cows, they would belong to the owner of the cows; in vain would the bull have spent his strength.

verses.text:
तथा-एव-अक्षेत्रिणो बीजं परक्षेत्रप्रवापिणः ।
कुर्वन्ति क्षेत्रिणाम् अर्थं न बीजी लभते फलम् ॥ ५१
                                    ॥
verses.english: Thus men who have no marital property in women, but sow their seed in the soil of others, benefit the owner of the woman; but the giver of the seed reaps no advantage.

verses.text:
फलं त्व् अन्.अभिसन्धाय क्षेत्रिणां बीजिनाम् तथा ।
प्रत्यक्षं क्षेत्रिणाम् अर्थो बीजाद् योनिर् गलीयसी ॥ ५२ ॥
                                        ९.५२च्व्/
                                        म्: बरीयसी ॥ 9.52 ॥
verses.english: If no agreement with respect to the crop has been made between the owner of the field and the owner of the seed, the benefit clearly belongs to the owner of the field; the receptacle is more important than the seed.

verses.text:
क्रियाभ्युपगमात् त्व् एतद् बीजार्थं यत् प्रदीयते ।
तस्य-इह भागिनौ दृष्टौ बीजी क्षेत्रिक एव च ॥ ५३
                                    ॥
verses.english: But if by a special contract (a field) is made over (to another) for sowing, then the owner of the seed and the owner of the soil are both considered in this world as sharers of the (crop).

verses.text:
ओघ.वाताहृतं बीजं यस्य क्षेत्रे प्ररोहति ।
क्षेत्रिकस्य-एव तद् बीजं न वप्ता लभते फलम् ॥ ५४
                                    ॥ ९.५४च्व्/
                                        म्: न बीजी लभते फलम् ॥ 9.54 ॥
verses.english: If seed be carried by water or wind into somebody's field and germinates (there), the (plant sprung from that) seed belongs even to the owner of the field, the owner of the seed does not receive the crop.

verses.text:
एष धर्मो गव.अश्वस्य दास्य्.उष्ट्र.अज.अविकस्य च ।
विहङ्ग.महिषीणां च विज्ञेयः प्रसवं प्रति ॥ ५५ ॥
verses.english: Know that such is the law concerning the offspring of cows, mares, slave-girls, female camels, she-goats, and ewes, as well as of females of birds and buffalo-cows.

verses.text:
एतद् वः सारफल्गुत्वं बीज.योन्योः प्रकीर्तितम् ।
अतः परं प्रवक्ष्यामि योषितां धर्मम् आपदि ॥ ५६ ॥
verses.english: Thus the comparative importance of the seed and of the womb has been declared to you; I will next propound the law (applicable) to women in times of misfortune.

verses.text:
भ्रातुर् ज्येष्ठस्य भार्या या गुरुपत्न्य् अनुजस्य सा ।
यवीयसस् तु या भार्या स्नुषा ज्येष्ठस्य सा स्मृता ॥ ५७
                                    ॥
verses.english: The wife of an elder brother is for his younger (brother) the wife of a Guru; but the wife of the younger is declared (to be) the daughter-in-law of the elder.

verses.text:
ज्येष्ठो यवीयसो भार्यां यवीयान् वा-अग्रजस्त्रियम् ।
पतितौ भवतो गत्वा नियुक्ताव् अप्य् अनापदि ॥ ५८ ॥
verses.english: An elder (brother) who approaches the wife of the younger, and a younger (brother who approaches) the wife of the elder, except in times of misfortune, both become outcasts, even though (they were duly) authorised.

verses.text:
देवराद् वा सपिण्डाद् वा स्त्रिया सम्यक्-नियुक्तया ।
प्रजा-ईप्सिताअ-अधिगन्तव्या सन्तानस्य परिक्षये ॥ ५९
                                    ॥
verses.english: On failure of issue (by her husband) a woman who has been authorised, may obtain, (in the) proper (manner prescribed), the desired offspring by (cohabitation with) a brother-in-law or (with some other) Sapinda (of the husband).

verses.text:
विधवायां नियुक्तस् तु घृताक्तो वाग्यतो निशि ।
एकम् उत्पादयेत् पुत्रं न द्वितीयं कथं चन ॥ ६०
                                    ॥
verses.english: He (who is) appointed to (cohabit with) the widow shall (approach her) at night anointed with clarified butter and silent, (and) beget one son, by no means a second.

verses.text:
द्वितीयम् एके प्रजनं मन्यन्ते स्त्रीषु तद्विदः ।
अ.निर्वृतं नियोगार्थं पश्यन्तो धर्मतस् तयोः ॥ ६१ ॥
                                        ९.६१च्व्/
                                        म्: अ.निर्वृत्तं ॥ 9.61 ॥
verses.english: Some (sages), versed in the law, considering the purpose of the appointment not to have been attained by those two (on the birth of the first), think that a second (son) may be lawfully procreated on (such) women.

verses.text:
विधवायां नियोगार्थे निर्वृत्ते तु यथाविधि । ९.६२अव्/ म्: 
                                        निवृत्ते
गुरुवत्-च स्नुषावत्-च वर्तेयातां परस्परम् ॥ ६२ ॥
verses.english: But when the purpose of the appointment to (cohabit with) the widow bas been attained in accordance with the law, those two shall behave towards each other like a father and a daughter-in-law.

verses.text:
नियुक्तौ यौ विधिं हित्वा वर्तेयातां तु कामतः ।
ताव् उभौ पतितौ स्यातां स्नुषाग.गुरुतल्पगौ ॥ ६३
                                    ॥
verses.english: If those two (being thus) appointed deviate from the rule and act from carnal desire, they will both become outcasts, (as men) who defile the bed of a daughter-in-law or of a Guru.

verses.text:
न-अन्यस्मिन् विधवा नारी नियोक्तव्या द्विजातिभिः ।
अन्यस्मिन् हि नियुञ्जाना धर्मं हन्युः सनातनम् ॥ ६४
                                    ॥
verses.english: By twice-born men a widow must not be appointed to (cohabit with) any other (than her husband); for they who appoint (her) to another (man), will violate the eternal law.

verses.text:
न-उद्वाहिकेषु मन्त्रेषु नियोगः कीर्त्यते क्व चित् ।
न विवाहविधाव् उक्तं विधवावेदनं पुनः ॥ ६५ ॥
verses.english: In the sacred texts which refer to marriage the appointment (of widows) is nowhere mentioned, nor is the re-marriage of widows prescribed in the rules concerning marriage.

verses.text:
अयं द्विजैर् हि विद्वद्भिः पशुधर्मो विगर्हितः ।
मनुष्याणाम् अपि प्रोक्तो वेने राज्यं प्रशासति ॥ ६६ ॥
verses.english: This practice which is reprehended by the learned of the twice-born castes as fit for cattle is said (to have occurred) even among men, while Vena ruled.

verses.text:
स महीम् अखिलां भुञ्जन् राजर्षिप्रवरः पुरा ।
वर्णानां सङ्करं चक्रे काम.उपहत.चेतनः ॥ ६७ ॥
verses.english: That chief of royal sages who formerly possessed the whole world, caused a confusion of the castes (varna), his intellect being destroyed by lust.

verses.text:
ततः प्रभृति यो मोहात् प्रमीत.पतिकां स्त्रियम् ।
नियोजयत्य् अपत्यार्थं तं विगर्हन्ति साधवः ॥ ६८
                                    ॥
verses.english: Since that (time) the virtuous censure that (man) who in his folly appoints a woman, whose husband died, to (bear) children (to another man).

verses.text:
यस्या म्रियेत कन्याया वाचा सत्ये कृते पतिः ।
ताम् अनेन विधानेन निजो विन्देत देवरः ॥ ६९ ॥
verses.english: If the (future) husband of a maiden dies after troth verbally plighted, her brother-in-law shall wed her according to the following rule.

verses.text:
यथाविधि-अधिगम्य-एनां शुक्ल.वस्त्रां शुचि.व्रताम् ।
मिथो भजेत-आ प्रसवात् सकृत्.सकृद् ऋताव्.ऋतौ ॥ ७०
                                    ॥
verses.english: Having, according to the rule, espoused her (who must be) clad in white garments and be intent on purity, he shall approach her once in each proper season until issue (be had).

verses.text:
न दत्त्वा कस्य चित् कन्यां पुनर् दद्याद् विचक्षणः ।
दत्त्वा पुनः प्रयच्छन् हि प्राप्नोति पुरुषानृतम् ॥ ७१
                                    ॥
verses.english: Let no prudent man, after giving his daughter to one (man), give her again to another; for he who gives (his daughter) whom he had before given, incurs (the guilt of) speaking falsely regarding a human being.

verses.text:
विधिवत् प्रतिगृह्य-अपि त्यजेत् कन्यां विगर्हिताम् ।
व्याधितां विप्रदुष्टां वा छद्मना च-उपपादिताम् ॥ ७२
                                    ॥
verses.english: Though (a man) may have accepted a damsel in due form, he may abandon (her if she be) blemished, diseased, or deflowered, and (if she have been) given with fraud.

verses.text:
यस् तु दोषवतीं कन्याम् अन्.आख्याय-उपपादयेत् ।
तस्य तद् वितथं कुर्यात् कन्यादातुर् दुरात्मनः ॥ ७३
                                    ॥
verses.english: If anybody gives away a maiden possessing blemishes without declaring them, (the bridegroom) may annul that (contract) with the evil-minded giver.

verses.text:
विधाय वृत्तिं भार्यायाः प्रवसेत् कार्यवान् नरः ।
अवृत्तिकर्शिता हि स्त्री प्रदुष्येत् स्थितिमत्य् अपि ॥ ७४
                                    ॥
verses.english: A man who has business (abroad) may depart after securing a maintenance for his wife; for a wife, even though virtuous, may be corrupted if she be distressed by want of subsistence.

verses.text:
विधाय प्रोषिते वृत्तिं जीवेन् नियमम् आस्थिता ।
प्रोषिते त्व् अ.विधाय-एव जीवेत्-शिल्पैर् अगर्हितैः ॥ ७५
                                    ॥
verses.english: If (the husband) went on a journey after providing (for her), the wife shall subject herself to restraints in her daily life; but if he departed without providing (for her), she may subsist by blameless manual work.

verses.text:
प्रोषितो धर्मकार्यार्थं प्रतीक्ष्यो ऽष्टौ नरः समाः
                                    ।
विद्यार्थं षड् यशो.ऽर्थं वा कामार्थं त्रींस् तु वत्सरान्
                                    ॥ ७६ ॥
verses.english: If the husband went abroad for some sacred duty, (she) must wait for him eight years, if (he went) to (acquire) learning or fame six (years), if (he went) for pleasure three years.

verses.text:
संवत्सरं प्रतीक्षेत द्विषन्तीं योषितं पतिः । ९.७७अव्/ म्: 
                                        द्विषाणां
ऊर्ध्वं संवत्सरात् त्व् एनां दायं हृत्वा न संवसेत् ॥ ७७
                                    ॥
verses.english: For one year let a husband bear with a wife who hates him; but after (the lapse of) a year let him deprive her of her property and cease to cohabit with her.

verses.text:
अतिक्रामेत् प्रमत्तं या मत्तं रोगार्तम् एव वा ।
सा त्रीन् मासान् परित्याज्या विभूषण.परिच्छदा ॥ ७८
                                    ॥
verses.english: She who shows disrespect to (a husband) who is addicted to (some evil) passion, is a drunkard, or diseased, shall be deserted for three months (and be) deprived of her ornaments and furniture.

verses.text:
उन्मत्तं पतितं क्लीबम् अ.बीजं पापरोगिणम् ।
न त्यागो ऽस्ति द्विषन्त्याश् च न च दायापवर्तनम् ॥ ७९
                                    ॥
verses.english: But she who shows aversion towards a mad or outcast (husband), a eunuch, one destitute of manly strength, or one afflicted with such diseases as punish crimes, shall neither be cast off nor be deprived of her property.

verses.text:
मद्यपा-असाधुवृत्ता च प्रतिकूला च या भवेत् । ९.८०अव्/ म्: 
                                        मद्यप.असत्यवृत्ता
व्याधिता वा-अधिवेत्तव्या हिंस्रा-अर्थघ्नी च सर्वदा ॥
                                    ८० ॥
verses.english: She who drinks spirituous liquor, is of bad conduct, rebellious, diseased, mischievous, or wasteful, may at any time be superseded (by another wife).

verses.text:
वन्ध्याष्टमे ऽधिवेद्या-ऽब्दे दशमे तु मृत.प्रजा ।
एकादशे स्त्रीजननी सद्यस् त्व् अप्रियवादिनी ॥ ८१ ॥
verses.english: A barren wife may be superseded in the eighth year, she whose children (all) die in the tenth, she who bears only daughters in the eleventh, but she who is quarrelsome without delay.

verses.text:
या रोगिणी स्यात् तु हिता सम्पन्ना च-एव शीलतः ।
सा-अनुज्ञाप्य-अधिवेत्तव्या न-अवमान्या च कर्हि चित् ॥ ८२
                                    ॥
verses.english: But a sick wife who is kind (to her husband) and virtuous in her conduct, may be superseded (only) with her own consent and must never be disgraced.

verses.text:
अधिविन्ना तु या नारी निर्गच्छेद् रुषिता गृहात् ।
सा सद्यः सन्निरोद्धव्या त्याज्या वा कुलसन्निधौ ॥ ८३
                                    ॥
verses.english: A wife who, being superseded, in anger departs from (her husband's) house, must either be instantly confined or cast off in the presence of the family.

verses.text:
प्रतिषिद्धा-अपि चेद् या तु मद्यम् अभ्युदयेष्व् अपि । ९.८४अव्/ म्: 
                                        प्रतिषेधे पिबेद् या तु
प्रेक्षा.समाजं गच्छेद् वा सा दण्ड्या कृष्णलानि षट् ॥ ८४
                                    ॥
verses.english: But she who, though having been forbidden, drinks spirituous liquor even at festivals, or goes to public spectacles or assemblies, shall be fined six krishnalas.

verses.text:
यदि स्वाश् च-अपराश् च-एव विन्देरन् योषितो द्विजाः ।
तासां वर्णक्रमेण स्याज् ज्येष्ठ्यं पूजा च वेश्म च ॥ ८५
                                    ॥
verses.english: If twice-born men wed women of their own and of other (lower castes), the seniority, honour, and habitation of those (wives) must be (settled) according to the order of the castes (varna).

verses.text:
भर्तुः शरीरशुश्रूषां धर्मकार्यं च नैत्यकम् ।
स्वा च-एव कुर्यात् सर्वेषां न-अस्वजातिः कथं चन ॥ ८६
                                    ॥ ९.८६च्व्/
                                        म्: स्वा स्वा-एव ॥ 9.86 ॥
verses.english: Among all (twice-born men) the wife of equal caste alone, not a wife of a different caste by any means, shall personally attend her husband and assist him in his daily sacred rites.

verses.text:
यस् तु तत् कारयेन् मोहात् स.जात्या स्थितया-अन्यया ।
यथा ब्राह्मणचाण्डालः पूर्वदृष्टस् तथा-एव सः ॥ ८७
                                    ॥
verses.english: But he who foolishly causes that (duty) to be performed by another, while his wife of equal caste is alive, is declared by the ancients (to be) as (despicable) as a Kandala (sprung from the) Brahmana (caste).

verses.text:
उत्कृष्टाय-अभिरूपाय वराय सदृशाय च ।
अप्राप्ताम् अपि तां तस्मै कन्यां दद्याद् यथाविधि ॥ ८८
                                    ॥
verses.english: To a distinguished, handsome suitor (of) equal (caste) should (a father) give his daughter in accordance with the prescribed rule, though she have not attained (the proper age).

verses.text:
कामम् आ मरणात् तिष्ठेद् गृहे कन्या-ऋतुमत्य् अपि ।
न च-एव-एनां प्रयच्चेत् तु गुण.हीनाय कर्हि चित् ॥ ८९
                                    ॥
verses.english: (But) the maiden, though marriageable, should rather stop in (the father's) house until death, than that he should ever give her to a man destitute of good qualities.

verses.text:
त्रीणि वर्षाण्य् उदीक्षेत कुमार्य् ऋतुमती सती ।
ऊर्ध्वं तु कालाद् एतस्माद् विन्देत सदृशं पतिम् ॥ ९०
                                    ॥
verses.english: Three years let a damsel wait, though she be marriageable; but after that time let her choose for herself a bridegroom (of) equal (caste and rank).

verses.text:
अ.दीयमाना भर्तारम् अधिगच्छेद् यदि स्वयम् ।
न-एनः किं चिद् अवाप्नोति न च यं सा-अधिगच्छति ॥ ९१
                                    ॥
verses.english: If, being not given in marriage, she herself seeks a husband, she incurs no guilt, nor (does) he whom she weds.

verses.text:
अलङ्कारं न-आददीत पित्र्यं कन्या स्वयंवरा ।
मातृकं भ्रातृदत्तं वा स्तेना स्याद् यदि तं हरेत् ॥ ९२
                                    ॥
verses.english: A maiden who choses for herself, shall not take with her any ornaments, given by her father or her mother, or her brothers; if she carries them away, it will be theft.

verses.text:
पित्रे न दद्यात्-शुल्कं तु कन्याम् ऋतुमतीं हरन् ।
स च स्वाम्याद् अतिक्रामेद् ऋतूनां प्रतिरोधनात् ॥ ९३ ॥
verses.english: But he who takes (to wife) a marriageable damsel, shall not pay any nuptial fee to her father; for the (latter) will lose his dominion over her in consequence of his preventing (the legitimate result of the appearance of) her enemies.

verses.text:
त्रिंशद्वर्षो वहेत् कन्यां हृद्यां द्वादशवार्षिकीम् ।
त्र्यष्टवर्षो ऽष्टवर्षां वा धर्मे सीदति सत्वरः ॥ ९४
                                    ॥
verses.english: A man, aged thirty years, shall marry a maiden of twelve who pleases him, or a man of twenty-four a girl eight years of age; if (the performance of) his duties would (otherwise) be impeded, (he must marry) sooner.

verses.text:
देवदत्तां पतिर् भार्यां विन्दते न-इच्छया-आत्मनः ।
तां साध्वीं बिभृयान् नित्यं देवानां प्रियम् आचरन् ॥ ९५
                                    ॥
verses.english: The husband receives his wife from the gods, (he does not wed her) according to his own will; doing what is agreeable to the gods, he must always support her (while she is) faithful.

verses.text:
प्रजनार्थं स्त्रियः सृष्टाः सन्तानार्थं च मानवः ।
तस्मात् साधारणो धर्मः श्रुतौ पत्न्या सह.उदितः ॥ ९६
                                    ॥
verses.english: To be mothers were women created, and to be fathers men; religious rites, therefore, are ordained in the Veda to be performed (by the husband) together with the wife.

verses.text:
कन्यायां दत्त.शुल्कायां म्रियेत यदि शुल्कदः ।
देवराय प्रदातव्या यदि कन्या-अनुमन्यते ॥ ९७ ॥
verses.english: If, after the nuptial fee has been paid for a maiden, the giver of the fee dies, she shall be given in marriage to his brother, in case she consents.

verses.text:
आददीत न शूद्रो ऽपि शुल्कं दुहितरं ददन् ।
शुल्कं हि गृह्णन् कुरुते छन्नं दुहितृविक्रयम् ॥ ९८
                                    ॥
verses.english: Even a Sudra ought not to take a nuptial fee, when he gives away his daughter; for he who takes a fee sell his daughter, covering (the transaction by another name).

verses.text:
एतत् तु न परे चक्रुर् न-अपरे जातु साधवः ।
यद् अन्यस्य प्रतिज्ञाय पुनर् अन्यस्य दीयते ॥ ९९ ॥
verses.english: Neither ancients nor moderns who were good men have done such (a deed) that, after promising (a daughter) to one man, they have her to another;

verses.text:
न-अनुशुश्रुम जातु-एतत् पूर्वेष्व् अपि हि जन्मसु ।
शुल्क.सञ्ज्ञेन मूल्येन छन्नं दुहितृविक्रयम् ॥ १००
                                    ॥
verses.english: Nor, indeed, have we heard, even in former creations, of such (a thing as) the covert sale of a daughter for a fixed price, called a nuptial fee.

verses.text:
अन्योन्यस्य-अव्यभिचारो भवेद् आ.मरणान्तिकः ।
एष धर्मः समासेन ज्ञेयः स्त्री.पुंसयोः परः ॥ १०१
                                    ॥
verses.english: 'Let mutual fidelity continue until death,' this may be considered as the summary of the highest law for husband and wife.

verses.text:
तथा नित्यं यतेयातां स्त्री.पुंसौ तु कृत.क्रियौ ।
यथा नाभिचरेतां तौ वियुक्ताव् इतरेतरम् ॥ १०२ ॥
                                        ९.१०२च्व्/
                                        म्: न-अतिचरेतां ॥ 9.102 ॥
verses.english: Let man and woman, united in marriage, constantly exert themselves, that (they may not be) disunited (and) may not violate their mutual fidelity.

verses.text:
एष स्त्री.पुंसयोर् उक्तो धर्मो वो रतिसंहितः ।
आपद्य् अपत्यप्राप्तिश् च दायधर्मं निबोधत ॥ १०३
                                    ॥
verses.english: Thus has been declared to you the law for a husband and his wife, which is intimately connected with conjugal happiness, and the manner of raising offspring in times of calamity; learn (now the law concerning) the division of the inheritance.

verses.text:
ऊर्ध्वं पितुश् च मातुश् च समेत्य भ्रातरः समम् ।
भजेरन् पैतृकं रिक्थम् अनीशास् ते हि जीवतोः ॥ १०४ ॥
verses.english: After the death of the father and of the mother, the brothers, being assembled, may divide among themselves in equal shares the paternal (and the maternal) estate; for, they have no power (over it) while the parents live.

verses.text:
ज्येष्ठ एव तु गृह्णीयात् पित्र्यं धनम् अशेषतः ।
शेषास् तम् उपजीवेयुर् यथा-एव पितरं तथा ॥ १०५
                                    ॥
verses.english: (Or) the eldest alone may take the whole paternal estate, the others shall live under him just as (they lived) under their father.

verses.text:
ज्येष्ठेन जातमात्रेण पुत्री भवति मानवः ।
पितॄणाम् अन्.ऋणश् च-एव स तस्मात् सर्वम् अर्हति ॥ १०६
                                    ॥
verses.english: Immediately on the birth of his first-born a man is (called) the father of a son and is freed from the debt to the manes; that (son), therefore, is worthy (to receive) the whole estate.

verses.text:
यस्मिन्न् ऋणं सन्नयति येन च-अनन्त्यम् अश्नुते ।
स एव धर्मजः पुत्रः कामजान् इतरान् विदुः ॥ १०७
                                    ॥
verses.english: That son alone on whom he throws his debt and through whom he obtains immortality, is begotten for (the fulfilment of) the law; all the rest they consider the offspring of desire.

verses.text:
पिता-इव पालयेत् पूत्रान् ज्येष्ठो भ्रातॄण् यवीयसः ।
पुत्रवत्-च-अपि वर्तेरन् ज्येष्ठे भ्रातरि धर्मतः ॥
                                    १०८ ॥
verses.english: As a father (supports) his sons, so let the eldest support his younger brothers, and let them also in accordance with the law behave towards their eldest brother as sons (behave towards their father).

verses.text:
ज्येष्ठः कुलं वर्धयति विनाशयति वा पुनः ।
ज्येष्ठः पूज्यतमो लोके ज्येष्ठः सद्भिर् अ.गर्हितः ॥
                                    १०९ ॥
verses.english: The eldest (son) makes the family prosperous or, on the contrary, brings it to ruin; the eldest (is considered) among men most worthy of honour, the eldest is not treated with disrespect by the virtuous.

verses.text:
यो ज्येष्ठो ज्येष्ठ.वृत्तिः स्यान् माता-इव स पिता-इव सः
                                    ।
अ.ज्येष्ठवृत्तिर् यस् तु स्यात् स सम्पूज्यस् तु बन्धुवत् ॥
                                    ११० ॥
verses.english: If the eldest brother behaves as an eldest brother (ought to do), he (must be treated) like a mother and like a father; but if he behaves in a manner unworthy of an eldest brother, he should yet be honoured like a kinsman.

verses.text:
एवं सह वसेयुर् वा पृथग् वा धर्मकाम्यया ।
पृथग् विवर्धते धर्मस् तस्माद् धर्म्या पृथक्क्रिया ॥
                                    १११ ॥
verses.english: Either let them thus live together, or apart, if (each) desires (to gain) spiritual merit; for (by their living) separate (their) merit increases, hence separation is meritorious.

verses.text:
ज्येष्ठस्य विंश उद्धारः सर्वद्रव्याच् च यद् वरम्
                                    ।
ततो ऽर्धं मध्यमस्य स्यात् तुरीयं तु यवीयसः ॥ ११२
                                    ॥
verses.english: The additional share (deducted) for the eldest shall be one-twentieth (of the estate) and the best of all chattels, for the middlemost half of that, but for the youngest one-fourth.

verses.text:
ज्येष्ठश् च-एव कनिष्ठश् च संहरेतां यथा.उदितम्
                                    ।
ये ऽन्ये ज्येष्ठ.कनिष्ठाभ्यां तेषां स्यान् मध्यमं
                                    धनम् ॥ ११३ ॥
verses.english: Both the eldest and the youngest shall take (their shares) according to (the rule just) stated (each of) those who are between the eldest and the youngest, shall have the share (prescribed for the) middlemost.

verses.text:
सर्वेषां धनजातानाम् आददीत-अग्र्यम् अग्रजः ।
यच् च सातिशयं किं चिद् दशतश् च-आप्नुयाद् वरम् ॥ ११४
                                    ॥
verses.english: Among the goods of every kind the eldest shall take the best (article), and (even a single chattel) which is particularly good, as well as the best of ten (animals).

verses.text:
उद्धारो न दशस्व् अस्ति सम्पन्नानां स्वकर्मसु ।
यत् किं चिद् एव देयं तु ज्यायसे मान.वर्धनम् ॥ ११५
                                    ॥
verses.english: But among (brothers) equally skilled in their occupations, there is no additional share, (consisting of the best animal) among ten; some trifle only shall be given to the eldest as a token of respect.

verses.text:
एवं समुद्धृत.उद्धारे समान् अंशान् प्रकल्पयेत् ।
उद्धारे ऽन्.उद्धृते त्व् एषाम् इयं स्याद् अंशकल्पना ॥ ११६
                                    ॥
verses.english: If additional shares are thus deducted, one must allot equal shares (out of the residue to each); but if no deduction is made, the allotment of the shares among them shall be (made) in the following manner.

verses.text:
एकाधिकं हरेज् ज्येष्ठः पुत्रो ऽध्यर्धं ततो ऽनुजः
                                    ।
अंशम् अंशं यवीयांस इति धर्मो व्यवस्थितः ॥ ११७
                                    ॥
verses.english: Let the eldest son take one share in excess, the (brother) born next after him one (share) and a half, the younger ones one share each; thus the law is settled.

verses.text:
स्वेभ्यो ऽंशेभ्यस् तु कन्याभ्यः प्रदद्युर् भ्रातरः
                                    पृथक् । ९.११८अव्/ म्: स्वाभ्यः स्वाभ्यस् तु
स्वात् स्वाद् अंशाच् चतुर्भागं पतिताः स्युर् अदित्सवः ॥
                                    ११८ ॥
verses.english: But to the maiden (sisters) the brothers shall severally give (portions) out of their shares, each out of his share one-fourth part; those who refuse to give (it), will become outcasts.

verses.text:
अज.आविकं स.एकशफं न जातु विषमं भजेत् । ९.११९अव्/ म्: 
                                        अज.आविकं च-एकशफं
अज.आविकं तु विषमं ज्येष्ठस्य-एव विधीयते ॥ ११९
                                    ॥
verses.english: Let him never divide (the value of) a single goat or sheep, or a (single beast) with uncloven hoofs; it is prescribed (that) a single goat or sheep (remaining after an equal division, belongs) to the eldest alone.

verses.text:
यवीयान्-ज्येष्ठभार्यायां पुत्रम् उत्पादयेद् यदि ।
समस् तत्र विभागः स्याद् इति धर्मो व्यवस्थितः ॥ १२०
                                    ॥
verses.english: If a younger brother begets a son on the wife of the elder, the division must then be made equally; this the law is settled.

verses.text:
उपसर्जनं प्रधानस्य धर्मतो न-उपपद्यते ।
पिता प्रधानं प्रजने तस्माद् धर्मेण तं भजेत् ॥ १२१
                                    ॥
verses.english: The representative (the son begotten on the wife) is not invested with the right of the principal (the eldest brother to an additional share); the principal (became) a father on the procreation (of a son by his younger brother); hence one should give a share to the (son begotten on the wife of the elder brother) according to the rule (stated above).

verses.text:
पुत्रः कनिष्ठो ज्येष्ठायां कनिष्ठायां च पूर्वजः ।
कथं तत्र विभागः स्याद् इति चेत् संशयो भवेत् ॥ १२२
                                    ॥
verses.english: If there be a doubt, how the division shall be made, in case the younger son is born of the elder wife and the elder son of the younger wife,

verses.text:
एकं वृषभम् उद्धारं संहरेत स पूर्वजः ।
ततो ऽपरे ज्येष्ठवृषास् तद्.ऊनानां स्वमातृतः ॥ १२३
                                    ॥
verses.english: (Then the son) born of the first wife shall take as his additional share one (most excellent) bull; the next best bulls (shall belong) to those (who are) inferior on account of their mothers.

verses.text:
ज्येष्ठस् तु जातो ज्येष्ठायां हरेद् वृषभ.षोडशाः ।
ततः स्वमातृतः शेषा भजेरन्न् इति धारणा ॥ १२४
                                    ॥
verses.english: But the eldest (son, being) born of the eldest wife, shall receive fifteen cows and a bull, the other sons may then take shares according to (the seniority of) their mothers; that is a settled rule.

verses.text:
सदृशस्त्रीषु जातानां पुत्राणाम् अविशेषतः ।
न मातृतो ज्यैष्ठ्यम् अस्ति जन्मतो ज्यैष्ठ्यम् उच्यते ॥
                                    १२५ ॥
verses.english: Between sons born of wives equal (in caste) (and) without (any other) distinction no seniority in right of the mother exists; seniority is declared (to be) according to birth.

verses.text:
जन्मज्येष्ठेन च-आह्वानं सुब्रह्मण्यास्व् अपि स्मृतम् ।
यमयोश् च-एव गर्भेषु जन्मतो ज्येष्ठता स्मृता ॥ १२६
                                    ॥
verses.english: And with respect to the Subrahmanya (texts) also it is recorded that the invocation (of Indra shall be made) by the first-born, of twins likewise, (conceived at one time) in the wombs (of their mothers) the seniority is declared (to depend) on (actual) birth.

verses.text:
अ.पुत्रो ऽनेन विधिना सुतां कुर्वीत पुत्रिकाम् ।
यद् अपत्यं भवेद् अस्यां तन् मम स्यात् स्वधाकरम् ॥
                                    १२७ ॥
verses.english: He who has no son may make his daughter in the following manner an appointed daughter (putrika, saying to her husband), 'The (male) child, born of her, shall perform my funeral rites.'

verses.text:
अनेन तु विधानेन पुरा चक्रे ऽथ पुत्रिकाः ।
विवृद्ध्यर्थं स्ववंशस्य स्वयं दक्षः प्रजापतिः ॥
                                    १२८ ॥
verses.english: According to this rule Daksha, himself, lord of created beings, formerly made (all his female offspring) appointed daughters in order to multiply his race.

verses.text:
ददौ स दश धर्माय कश्यपाय त्रयोदश ।
सोमाय राज्ञे सत्कृत्य प्रीत.आत्मा सप्तविंशतिम् ॥ १२९
                                    ॥
verses.english: He gave ten to Dharma, thirteen to Kasyapa, twenty-seven to King Soma, honouring (them) with an affectionate heart.

verses.text:
यथा-एव-आत्मा तथा पुत्रः पुत्रेण दुहिता समा ।
तस्याम् आत्मनि तिष्ठन्त्यां कथम् अन्यो धनं हरेत् ॥
                                    १३० ॥
verses.english: A son is even (as) oneself, (such) a daughter is equal to a son; how can another (heir) take the estate, while such (an appointed daughter who is even) oneself, lives?

verses.text:
मातुस् तु यौतकं यत् स्यात् कुमारीभाग एव सः ।
दौहित्र एव च हरेद् अ.पुत्रस्य-अखिलं धनम् ॥ १३१
                                    ॥
verses.english: But whatever may be the separate property of the mother, that is the share of the unmarried daughter alone; and the son of an (appointed) daughter shall take the whole estate of (his maternal grandfather) who leaves no son.

verses.text:
दौहित्रो ह्य् अ.खिलं रिक्थम् अ.पुत्रस्य पितुर् हरेत्
                                    ।
स एव दद्याद् द्वौ पिण्डौ पित्रे मातामहाय च ॥ १३२
                                    ॥
verses.english: The son of an (appointed) daughter, indeed, shall (also) take the estate of his (own) father, who leaves no (other) son; he shall (then) present two funeral cakes to his own father and to his maternal grandfather.

verses.text:
पौत्र.दौहित्रयोर् लोके न विशेषो ऽस्ति धर्मतः ।
तयोर् हि माता.पितरौ सम्भूतौ तस्य देहतः ॥ १३३
                                    ॥
verses.english: Between a son's son and the son of an (appointed) daughter there is no difference, neither with respect to worldly matters nor to sacred duties; for their father and mother both sprang from the body of the same (man).

verses.text:
पुत्रिकायां कृतायां तु यदि पुत्रो ऽनुजायते ।
समस् तत्र विभागः स्यात्-ज्येष्ठता न-अस्ति हि स्त्रियाः
                                    ॥ १३४ ॥
verses.english: But if, after a daughter has been appointed, a son be born (to her father), the division (of the inheritance) must in that (case) be equal; for there is no right of primogeniture for a woman.

verses.text:
अ.पुत्रायां मृतायां तु पुत्रिकायां कथं चन ।
धनं तत् पुत्रिकाभर्ता हरेत-एव-अ.विचारयन् ॥ १३५
                                    ॥
verses.english: But if an appointed daughter by accident dies without (leaving) a son, the husband of the appointed daughter may, without hesitation, take that estate.

verses.text:
अकृता वा कृता वा-अपि यं विन्देत् सदृशात् सुतम् ।
पौत्री मातामहस् तेन दद्यात् पिण्डं हरेद् धनम् ॥ १३६
                                    ॥
verses.english: Through that son whom (a daughter), either not appointed or appointed, may bear to (a husband) of equal (caste), his maternal grandfather (has) a son's son; he shall present the funeral cake and take the estate.

verses.text:
पुत्रेण लोकान्-जयति पौत्रेण-आनन्त्यम् अश्नुते ।
अथ पुत्रस्य पौत्रेण ब्रध्नस्य-आप्नोति विष्टपम् ॥ १३७
                                    ॥
verses.english: Through a son he conquers the worlds, through a son's son he obtains immortality, but through his son's grandson he gains the world of the sun.

verses.text:
पुत्.नाम्नो नरकाद् यस्मात् त्रायते पितरं सुतः ।
तस्मात् पुत्र इति प्रोक्तः स्वयम् एव स्वयम्भुवा ॥ १३८
                                    ॥
verses.english: Because a son delivers (trayate) his father from the hell called Put, he was therefore called put-tra (a deliverer from Put) by the Self-existent (Svayambhu) himself.

verses.text:
पौत्र.दौहित्रयोर् लोके विशेषो न-उपपद्यते ।
दौहित्रो ऽपि ह्य् अमुत्र-एनं सन्तारयति पौत्रवत् ॥ १३९
                                    ॥
verses.english: Between a son's son and the son of a daughter there exists in this world no difference; for even the son of a daughter saves him (who has no sons) in the next world, like the son's son.

verses.text:
मातुः प्रथमतः पिण्डं निर्वपेत् पुत्रिकासुतः ।
द्वितीयं तु पितुस् तस्यास् तृतीयं तत्पितुः पितुः ॥ १४०
                                    ॥
verses.english: Let the son of an appointed daughter first present a funeral cake to his mother, the second to her father, the funeral to his father's father.

verses.text:
उपपन्नो गुणैः सर्वैः पुत्रो यस्य तु दत्त्रिमः ।
स हरेत-एव तद्रिक्थं सम्प्राप्तो ऽप्य् अन्यगोत्रतः ॥
                                    १४१ ॥
verses.english: Of the man who has an adopted (Datrima) son possessing all good qualities, that same (son) shall take the inheritance, though brought from another family.

verses.text:
गोत्र.रिक्थे जनयितुर् न हरेद् दत्त्रिमः क्व चित् ।
गोत्र.रिक्थानुगः पिण्डो व्यपैति ददतः स्वधा ॥ १४२
                                    ॥
verses.english: An adopted son shall never take the family (name) and the estate of his natural father; the funeral cake follows the family (name) and the estate, the funeral offerings of him who gives (his son in adoption) cease (as far as that son is concerned).

verses.text:
अनियुक्तासुतश् च-एव पुत्रिण्या-आप्तश् च देवरात् ।
उभौ तौ न-अर्हतो भागं जारजातक.कामजौ ॥ १४३
                                    ॥
verses.english: The son of a wife, not appointed (to have issue by another), and he whom (an appointed female, already) the mother of a son, bears to her brother-in-law, are both unworthy of a share, (one being) the son of an adulterer and (the other) produced through (mere) lust.

verses.text:
नियुक्तायाम् अपि पुमान् नार्यां जातो ऽविधानतः ।
न-एव-अर्हः पैतृकं रिक्थं पतित.उत्पादितो हि सः ॥
                                    १४४ ॥
verses.english: Even the male (child) of a female (duly) appointed, not begotten according to the rule (given above), is unworthy of the paternal estate; for he was procreated by an outcast.

verses.text:
हरेत् तत्र नियुक्तायां जातः पुत्रो यथा-औरसः ।
क्षेत्रिकस्य तु तद् बीजं धर्मतः प्रसवश् च सः ॥
                                    १४५ ॥
verses.english: A son (legally) begotten on such an appointed female shall inherit like a legitimate son of the body; for that seed and the produce belong, according to the law, to the owner of the soil.

verses.text:
धनं यो बिभृयाद् भ्रातुर् मृतस्य स्त्रियम् एव च ।
सो ऽपत्यं भ्रातुर् उत्पाद्य दद्यात् तस्य-एव तद्धनम् ॥
                                    १४६ ॥
verses.english: He who takes care of his deceased brother's estate and of his widow, shall, after raising up a son for his brother, give that property even to that (son).

verses.text:
या नियुक्ता-अन्यतः पुत्रं देवराद् वा-अप्य् अवाप्नुयात् ।
तं कामजम् अ.रिक्थीयं वृथा.उत्पन्नं प्रचक्षते ॥ १४७
                                    ॥ ९.१४७च्व्/
                                        म्: मिथ्या.उत्पन्नं ॥ 9.147 ॥
verses.english: If a woman (duly) appointed bears a son to her brother-in-law or to another (Sapinda), that (son, if he is) begotten through desire, they declare (to be) incapable of inheriting and to be produced in vain.

verses.text:
एतद् विधानं विज्ञेयं विभागस्य-एकयोनिषु ।
बह्वीषु च-एकजातानां नानास्त्रीषु निबोधत ॥ १४८ ॥
verses.english: The rules (given above) must be understood (to apply) to a distribution among sons of women of the same (caste); hear (now the law) concerning those begotten by one man on many wives of different (castes).

verses.text:
ब्राह्मणस्य-अनुपूर्व्येण चतस्रस् तु यदि स्त्रियः ।
तासां पुत्रेषु जातेषु विभागे ऽयं विधिः स्मृतः ॥ १४९
                                    ॥
verses.english: If there be four wives of a Brahmana in the direct order of the castes, the rule for the division (of the estate) among the sons born of them is as follows:

verses.text:
कीनाशो गोवृषो यानम् अलङ्कारश् च वेश्म च ।
विप्रस्य-औद्धारिकं देयम् एकांशश् च प्रधानतः ॥ १५०
                                    ॥
verses.english: The (slave) who tills (the field), the bull kept for impregnating cows, the vehicle, the ornaments, and the house shall be given as an additional portion to the Brahmana (son), and one most excellent share.

verses.text:
त्र्यंशं दायाद्द् हरेद् विप्रो द्वाव् अंशौ क्षत्रियासुतः
                                    ।
वैश्याजः स.अर्धम् एव-अंशम् अंशं शूद्रासुतो हरेत् ॥
                                    १५१ ॥
verses.english: Let the son of the Brahmana (wife) take three shares of the (remainder of the) estate, the son of the Kshatriya two, the son of the Vaisya a share and a half, and the son of the Sudra may take one share.

verses.text:
सर्वं वा रिक्थजातं तद् दशधा परिकल्प्य च ।
धर्म्यं विभागं कुर्वीत विधिना-अनेन धर्मवित् ॥ १५२
                                    ॥
verses.english: Or let him who knows the law make ten shares of the whole estate, and justly distribute them according to the following rule:

verses.text:
चतुरो ऽंशान् हरेद् विप्रस् त्रीन् अंशान् क्षत्रियासुतः ।
वैश्यापुत्रो हरेद् द्व्यंशं अंशं शूद्रासुतो हरेत् ॥ १५३
                                    ॥
verses.english: The Brahmana (son) shall take four shares, son of the Kshatriya (wife) three, the son of the Vaisya shall have two parts, the son of the Sudra may take one share.

verses.text:
यद्य् अपि स्यात् तु सत्.पुत्रो ऽप्य् असत्.पुत्रो ऽपि वा भवेत्
                                    । ९.१५४अव्/
                                        म्: यद्य् अपि स्यात् तु सत्.पुत्रो यद्य् अ.पुत्रो ऽपि वा
                                        भवेत्
न-अधिकं दशमाद् दद्यात्-शूद्रापुत्राय धर्मतः ॥ १५४
                                    ॥
verses.english: Whether (a Brahmana) have sons or have no sons (by wives of the twice-born castes), the (heir) must, according to the law, give to the son of a Sudra (wife) no more than a tenth (part of his estate).

verses.text:
ब्राह्मण.क्षत्रिय.विशां शूद्रापुत्रो न रिक्थभाक् ।
यद् एव-अस्य पिता दद्यात् तद् एव-अस्य धनं भवेत् ॥
                                    १५५ ॥
verses.english: The son of a Brahmana, a Kshatriya, and a Vaisya by a Sudra (wife) receives no share of the inheritance; whatever his father may give to him, that shall be his property.

verses.text:
सम.वर्णासु वा जाताः सर्वे पुत्रा द्विजन्मनाम् ।
उद्धारं ज्यायसे दत्त्वा भजेरन्न् इतरे समम् ॥ १५६
                                    ॥
verses.english: All the sons of twice-born men, born of wives of the same caste, shall equally divide the estate, after the others have given to the eldest an additional share.

verses.text:
शूद्रस्य तु सवर्णा-एव न-अन्या भार्या विधीयते ।
तस्यां जाताः सम.अंशाः स्युर् यदि पुत्रशतं भवेत् ॥
                                    १५७ ॥
verses.english: For a Sudra is ordained a wife of his own caste only (and) no other; those born of her shall have equal shares, even if there be a hundred sons.

verses.text:
पुत्रान् द्वादश यान् आह नॄणां स्वायम्भुवो मनुः ।
तेषां षड् बन्धु.दायादाः षड् अदायाद.बान्धवाः ॥ १५८
                                    ॥
verses.english: Among the twelve sons of men whom Manu, sprung from the Self-existent (Svayambhu), enumerates, six are kinsmen and heirs, and six not heirs, (but) kinsmen.

verses.text:
औरसः क्षेत्रजश् च-एव दत्तः कृत्रिम एव च ।
गूढ.उत्पन्नो ऽपविद्धश् च दायादा बान्धवाश् च षट् ॥
                                    १५९ ॥
verses.english: The legitimate son of the body, the son begotten on a wife, the son adopted, the son made, the son secretly born, and the son cast off, (are) the six heirs and kinsmen.

verses.text:
कानीनश् च सहोढश् च क्रीतः पौनर्भवस् तथा ।
स्वयन्दत्तश् च शौद्रश् च षड् अदायाद.बान्धवाः ॥ १६०
                                    ॥
verses.english: The son of an unmarried damsel, the son received with the wife, the son bought, the son begotten on a re-married woman, the son self-given, and the son of a Sudra female, (are) the six (who are) not heirs, (but) kinsmen.

verses.text:
यादृशं फलम् आप्नोति कुप्लवैः सन्तरन्-जलम् ।
तादृशं फलम् आप्नोति कुपुत्रैः सन्तरंस् तमः ॥ १६१
                                    ॥
verses.english: Whatever result a man obtains who (tries to) cross a (sheet of) water in an unsafe boat, even that result obtains he who (tries to) pass the gloom (of the next world) with (the help of) bad (substitutes for a real) son.

verses.text:
यद्य् एकरिक्थिनौ स्याताम् औरस.क्षेत्रजौ सुतौ ।
यस्य यत् पैतृकं रिक्थं स तद् गृह्णीत न-इतरः ॥
                                    १६२ ॥
verses.english: If the two heirs of one man be a legitimate son of his body and a son begotten on his wife, each (of the two sons), to the exclusion of the other, shall take the estate of his (natural) father.

verses.text:
एक एव-औरसः पुत्रः पित्र्यस्य वसुनः प्रभुः ।
शेषाणाम् आनृशंस्यार्थं प्रदद्यात् तु प्रजीवनम् ॥ १६३
                                    ॥
verses.english: The legitimate son of the body alone (shall be) the owner of the paternal estate; but, in order to avoid harshness, let him allow a maintenance to the rest.

verses.text:
षष्ठं तु क्षेत्रजस्य-अंशं प्रदद्यात् पैतृकाद् धनात्
                                    ।
औरसो विभजन् दायं पित्र्यं पञ्चमम् एव वा ॥ १६४
                                    ॥
verses.english: But when the legitimate son of the body divides the paternal estate, he shall give one-sixth or one-fifth part of his father's property to the son begotten on the wife.

verses.text:
औरस.क्षेत्रजौ पुत्रौ पितृरिक्थस्य भागिनौ ।
दश-अपरे तु क्रमशो गोत्र.रिक्थांशभागिनः ॥ १६५
                                    ॥
verses.english: The legitimate son and the son of the wife (thus) share the father's estate; but the other tell become members of the family, and inherit according to their order (each later named on failure of those named earlier).

verses.text:
स्वक्षेत्रे संस्कृतायां तु स्वयम् उत्पादयेद्द् हि यम् ।
तम् औरसं विजानीयात् पुत्रं प्राथमकल्पिकम् ॥ १६६
                                    ॥
verses.english: Him whom a man begets on his own wedded wife, let him know to be a legitimate son of the body (Aurasa), the first in rank.

verses.text:
यस् तल्पजः प्रमीतस्य क्लीबस्य व्याधितस्य वा ।
स्वधर्मेण नियुक्तायां स पुत्रः क्षेत्रजः स्मृतः ॥ १६७
                                    ॥
verses.english: He who was begotten according to the peculiar law (of the Niyoga) on the appointed wife of a dead man, of a eunuch, or of one diseased, is called a son begotten on a wife (Kshetraga).

verses.text:
माता पिता वा दद्यातां यम् अद्भिः पुत्रम् आपदि ।
सदृशं प्रीतिसंयुक्तं स ज्ञेयो दत्त्रिमः सुतः ॥ १६८
                                    ॥
verses.english: That (boy) equal (by caste) whom his mother or his father affectionately give, (confirming the gift) with (a libation of) water, in times of distress (to a man) as his son, must be considered as an adopted son (Datrima).

verses.text:
सदृशं तु प्रकुर्याद् यं गुण.दोष.विचक्षणम् ।
पुत्रं पुत्रगुणैर् युक्तं स विज्ञेयश् च कृत्रिमः ॥ १६९
                                    ॥
verses.english: But he is considered a son made (Kritrima) whom (a man) makes his son, (he being) equal (by caste), acquainted with (the distinctions between) right and wrong, (and) endowed with filial virtues.

verses.text:
उत्पद्यते गृहे यस् तु न च ज्ञायेत कस्य सः ।
स गृहे गूढ उत्पन्नस् तस्य स्याद् यस्य तल्पजः ॥ १७०
                                    ॥
verses.english: If (a child) be born in a man's house and his father be not known, he is a son born secretly in the house (Gudhotpanna), and shall belong to him of whose wife he was born.

verses.text:
माता.पितृभ्याम् उत्सृष्टं तयोर् अन्यतरेण वा ।
यं पुत्रं परिगृह्णीयाद् अपविद्धः स उच्यते ॥ १७१
                                    ॥
verses.english: He whom (a man) receives as his son, (after he has been) deserted by his parents or by either of them, is called a son cast off (Apaviddha).

verses.text:
पितृवेश्मनि कन्या तु यं पुत्रं जनयेद् रहः ।
तं कानीनं वदेन् नाम्ना वोढुः कन्या.समुद्भवम् ॥ १७२
                                    ॥
verses.english: A son whom a damsel secretly bears in the house of her father, one shall name the son of an unmarried damsel (Kanina, and declare) such offspring of an unmarried girl (to belong) to him who weds her (afterwards).

verses.text:
या गर्भिणी संस्क्रियते ज्ञाता.अज्ञाता-अपि वा सती ।
वोढुः स गर्भो भवति सहोढ इति च-उच्यते ॥ १७३
                                    ॥
verses.english: If one marries, either knowingly or unknowingly, a pregnant (bride), the child in her womb belongs to him who weds her, and is called (a son) received with the bride (Sahodha).

verses.text:
क्रीणीयाद् यस् त्व् अपत्यार्थं माता.पित्रोर् यम् अन्तिकात्
                                    ।
स क्रीतकः सुतस् तस्य सदृशो ऽसदृशो ऽपि वा ॥ १७४
                                    ॥
verses.english: If a man buys a (boy), whether equal or unequal (in good qualities), from his father and mother for the sake of having a son, that (child) is called a (son) bought (Kritaka).

verses.text:
या पत्या वा परित्यक्ता विधवा वा स्वया-इच्छया ।
उत्पादयेत् पुनर् भूत्वा स पौनर्भव उच्यते ॥ १७५
                                    ॥
verses.english: If a woman abandoned by her husband, or a widow, of her own accord contracts a second marriage and bears (a son), he is called the son of a re-married woman (Paunarbhava).

verses.text:
सा चेद् अक्षत.योनिः स्याद् गत.प्रत्यागता-अपि वा ।
पौनर्भवेन भर्त्रा सा पुनः संस्कारम् अर्हति ॥ १७६
                                    ॥
verses.english: If she be (still) a virgin, or one who returned (to her first husband) after leaving him, she is worthy to again perform with her second (or first deserted) husband the (nuptial) ceremony.

verses.text:
माता.पितृ.विहीनो यस् त्यक्तो वा स्याद् अकारणात् ।
आत्मानम् अर्पयेद् यस्मै स्वयन्दत्तस् तु स स्मृतः ॥ १७७
                                    ॥
verses.english: He who, having lost his parents or being abandoned (by them) without (just) cause, gives himself to a (man), is called a son self-given (Svayamdatta).

verses.text:
यं ब्राह्मणस् तु शूद्रायां कामाद् उत्पादयेत् सुतम् ।
स पारयन्न् एव शवस् तस्मात् पारशवः स्मृतः ॥ १७८
                                    ॥
verses.english: The son whom a Brahmana begets through lust on a Sudra female is, (though) alive (parayan), a corpse (sava), and hence called a Parasava (a living corpse).

verses.text:
दास्यां वा दासदास्यां वा यः शूद्रस्य सुतो भवेत् ।
सो ऽनुज्ञातो हरेद् अंशम् इति धर्मो व्यवस्थितः ॥ १७९
                                    ॥
verses.english: A son who is (begotten) by a Sudra on a female slave, or on the female slave of his slave, may, if permitted (by his father), take a share (of the inheritance); thus the law is settled.

verses.text:
क्षेत्रज.आदीन् सुतान् एतान् एकादश यथा.उदितान् ।
पुत्रप्रतिनिधीन् आहुः क्रियालोपान् मनीषिणः ॥ १८० ॥
verses.english: These eleven, the son begotten on the wife and the rest as enumerated (above), the wise call substitutes for a son, (taken) in order (to prevent) a failure of the (funeral) ceremonies.

verses.text:
य एते ऽभिहिताः पुत्राः प्रसङ्गाद् अन्यबीजजाः ।
यस्य ते बीजतो जातास् तस्य ते न-इतरस्य तु ॥ १८१
                                    ॥
verses.english: Those sons, who have been mentioned in connection with (the legitimate son of the body), being begotten by strangers, belong (in reality) to him from whose seed they sprang, but not to the other (man who took them).

verses.text:
भ्रातॄणाम् एकजातानाम् एकश् चेत् पुत्रवान् भवेत् ।
सर्वांस् तांस् तेन पुत्रेण पुत्रिणो मनुर् अब्रवीत् ॥ १८२
                                    ॥
verses.english: If among brothers, sprung from one (father), one have a son, Manu has declared them all to have male offspring through that son.

verses.text:
सर्वासाम् एक.पत्नीनाम् एका चेत् पुत्रिणी भवेत् ।
सर्वास् तास् तेन पुत्रेण प्राह पुत्रवतीर् मनुः ॥ १८३
                                    ॥
verses.english: If among all the wives of one husband one have a son, Manu declares them all (to be) mothers of male children through that son.

verses.text:
श्रेयसः श्रेयसो ऽलाभे पापीयान् रिक्थम् अर्हति ।
बहवश् चेत् तु सदृशाः सर्वे रिक्थस्य भागिनः ॥ १८४
                                    ॥
verses.english: On failure of each better (son), each next inferior (one) is worthy of the inheritance; but if there be many (of) equal (rank), they shall all share the estate.

verses.text:
न भ्रातरो न पितरः पुत्रा रिक्थहराः पितुः ।
पिता हरेद् अ.पुत्रस्य रिक्थं भ्रातर एव च ॥ १८५
                                    ॥
verses.english: Not brothers, nor fathers, (but) sons take the paternal estate; but the father shall take the inheritance of (a son) who leaves no male issue, and his brothers.

verses.text:
त्रयाणाम् उदकं कार्यं त्रिषु पिण्डः प्रवर्तते ।
चतुर्थः सम्प्रदाता-एषां पञ्चमो न-उपपद्यते ॥ १८६
                                    ॥
verses.english: To three (ancestors) water must be offered, to three the funeral cake is given, the fourth (descendant is) the giver of these (oblations), the fifth has no connection (with them).

verses.text:
अनन्तरः सपिण्डाद् यस् तस्य तस्य धनं भवेत् ।
अत ऊर्ध्वं सकुल्यः स्याद् आचार्यः शिष्य एव वा ॥ १८७
                                    ॥
verses.english: Always to that (relative within three degrees) who is nearest to the (deceased) Sapinda the estate shall belong; afterwards a Sakulya shall be (the heir, then) the spiritual teacher or the pupil.

verses.text:
सर्वेषाम् अप्य् अभावे तु ब्राह्मणा रिक्थभागिनः ।
त्रैविद्याः शुचयो दान्तास् तथा धर्मो न हीयते ॥ १८८
                                    ॥
verses.english: But on failure of all (heirs) Brahmanas (shall) share the estate, (who are) versed the in the three Vedas, pure and self-controlled; thus the law is not violated.

verses.text:
अ.हार्यं ब्राह्मणद्रव्यं राज्ञा नित्यम् इति स्थितिः ।
इतरेषां तु वर्णानां सर्व.अभावे हरेन् नृपः ॥ १८९
                                    ॥
verses.english: The property of a Brahmana must never be taken by the king, that is a settled rule; but (the property of men) of other castes the king may take on failure of all (heirs).

verses.text:
संस्थितस्य-अन्.अपत्यस्य सगोत्रात् पुत्रम् आहरेत् ।
तत्र यद् रिक्थजातं स्यात् तत् तस्मिन् प्रतिपादयेत् ॥
                                    १९० ॥
verses.english: (If the widow) of (a man) who died without leaving issue, raises up to him a son by a member of the family (Sagotra), she shall deliver to that (son) the whole property which belonged to the (deceased).

verses.text:
द्वौ तु यौ विवदेयातां द्वाभ्यां जातौ स्त्रिया धने
                                    ।
तयोर् यद् यस्य पित्र्यं स्यात् तत् स गृह्णीत न-इतरः ॥
                                    १९१ ॥
verses.english: But if two (sons), begotten by two (different men), contend for the property (in the hands) of their mother, each shall take, to the exclusion of the other, what belonged to his father.

verses.text:
जनन्यां संस्थितायां तु समं सर्वे सह.उदराः ।
भजेरन् मातृकं रिक्थं भगिन्यश् च स.नाभयः ॥ १९२
                                    ॥
verses.english: But when the mother has died, all the uterine brothers and the uterine sisters shall equally divide the mother's estate.

verses.text:
यास् तासां स्युर् दुहितरस् तासाम् अपि यथार्हतः । ९.१९३अव्/ ह्.
                                        तस्यां
मातामह्या धनात् किं चित् प्रदेयं प्रीतिपूर्वकम् ॥ १९३
                                    ॥
verses.english: Even to the daughters of those (daughters) something should be given, as is seemly, out of the estate of their maternal grandmother, on the score of affection.

verses.text:
अध्यग्नि.अध्यावाहनिकं दत्तं च प्रीतिकर्मणि ।
भ्रातृ.मातृ.पितृप्राप्तं षड्विधं स्त्रीधनं स्मृतम् ॥
                                    १९४ ॥
verses.english: What (was given) before the (nuptial) fire, what (was given) on the bridal procession, what was given in token of love, and what was received from her brother, mother, or father, that is called the sixfold property of a woman.

verses.text:
अन्वाधेयं च यद् दत्तं पत्या प्रीतेन च-एव यत् ।
पत्यौ जीवति वृत्तायाः प्रजायास् तद् धनं भवेत् ॥ १९५
                                    ॥
verses.english: (Such property), as well as a gift subsequent and what was given (to her) by her affectionate husband, shall go to her offspring, (even) if she dies in the lifetime of her husband.

verses.text:
ब्राह्म.दैव.आर्ष.गान्धर्व.प्राजापत्येषु यद् वसु ।
अ.प्रजायाम् अतीतायां भर्तुर् एव तद् इष्यते ॥ १९६ ॥
verses.english: It is ordained that the property (of a woman married) according to the Brahma, the Daiva, the Arsha, the Gandharva, or the Pragapatya rite (shall belong) to her husband alone, if she dies without issue.

verses.text:
यत् त्व् अस्याः स्याद् धनं दत्तं विवाहेष्व् आसुर.आदिषु
                                    ।
अ.प्रजायाम् अतीतायां माता.पित्रोस् तद् इष्यते ॥ १९७ ॥
verses.english: But it is prescribed that the property which may have been given to a (wife) on an Asura marriage or (one of the) other (blamable marriages, shall go) to her mother and to her father, if she dies without issue.

verses.text:
स्त्रियां तु यद् भवेद् वित्तं पित्रा दत्तं कथं चन
                                    ।
ब्राह्मणी तद्द् हरेत् कन्या तदपत्यस्य वा भवेत् ॥ १९८
                                    ॥
verses.english: Whatever property may have been given by her father to a wife (who has co-wives of different castes), that the daughter (of the) Brahmani (wife) shall take, or that (daughter's) issue.

verses.text:
न निर्हारं स्त्रियः कुर्युः कुटुम्बाद् बहुमध्यगात् ।
स्वकाद् अपि च वित्ताद्द् हि स्वस्य भर्तुर् अनाज्ञया ॥ १९९
                                    ॥
verses.english: Women should never make a hoard from (the property of) their families which is common to many, nor from their own (husbands' particular) property without permission.

verses.text:
पत्यौ जीवति यः स्त्रीभिर् अलङ्कारो धृतो भवेत् ।
न तं भजेरन् दायादा भजमानाः पतन्ति ते ॥ २००
                                    ॥
verses.english: The ornaments which may have been worn by women during their husbands' lifetime, his heirs shall not divide; those who divide them become outcasts.

verses.text:
अन्.अंशौ क्लीब.पतितौ जात्यन्ध.बधिरौ तथा ।
उन्मत्त.जड.मूकाश् च ये च के चिन् निर्.इन्द्रियाः ॥ २०१
                                    ॥
verses.english: Eunuchs and outcasts, (persons) born blind or deaf, the insane, idiots and the dumb, as well as those deficient in any organ (of action or sensation), receive no share.

verses.text:
सर्वेषाम् अपि तु न्याय्यं दातुं शक्त्या मनीषिणा ।
ग्रास.आच्छादनम् अत्यन्तं पतितो ह्य् अ.ददद् भवेत् ॥
                                    २०२ ॥
verses.english: But it is just that (a man) who knows (the law) should give even to all of them food and raiment without stint, according to his ability; he who gives it not will become all outcast.

verses.text:
यद्य् अर्थिता तु दारैः स्यात् क्लीबादीनां कथं चन ।
तेषाम् उत्पन्न.तन्तूनाम् अपत्यं दायम् अर्हति ॥ २०३
                                    ॥
verses.english: If the eunuch and the rest should somehow or other desire to (take) wives, the offspring of such among them as have children is worthy of a share.

verses.text:
यत् किं चित् पितरि प्रेते धनं ज्येष्ठो ऽधिगच्छति
                                    ।
भागो यवीयसां तत्र यदि विद्यानुपालिनः ॥ २०४ ॥
verses.english: Whatever property the eldest (son) acquires (by his own exertion) after the father's death, a share of that (shall belong) to his younger (brothers), provided they have made a due progress in learning.

verses.text:
अ.विद्यानां तु सर्वेषां ईहातश् चेद् धनं भवेत् ।
समस् तत्र विभागः स्याद् अपित्र्य इति धारणा ॥ २०५
                                    ॥
verses.english: But if all of them, being unlearned, acquire property by their labour, the division of that shall be equal, (as it is) not property acquired by the father; that is a settled rule.

verses.text:
विद्याधनं तु यद्य् अस्य तत् तस्य-एव धनं भवेत्
                                    ।
मैत्र्यम् औद्वाहिकं च-एव माधुपर्किकम् एव च ॥ २०६
                                    ॥
verses.english: Property (acquired) by learning belongs solely to him to whom (it was given), likewise the gift of a friend, a present received on marriage or with the honey-mixture.

verses.text:
भ्रातॄणां यस् तु न-ईहेत धनं शक्तः स्वकर्मणा ।
स निर्भाज्यः स्वकाद् अंशात् किं चिद् दत्त्वा-उपजीवनम् ॥
                                    २०७ ॥
verses.english: But if one of the brothers, being able (to maintain himself) by his own occupation, does not desire (a share of the family) property, he may be made separate (by the others) receiving a trifle out of his share to live upon.

verses.text:
अन्.उपघ्नन् पितृद्रव्यं श्रमेण यद् उपार्जितम् ।
स्वयम् ईहितलब्धं तन् न-अ.कामो दातुम् अर्हति ॥ २०८
                                    ॥
verses.english: What one (brother) may acquire by his labour without using the patrimony, that acquisition, (made solely) by his own effort, he shall not share unless by his own will (with his brothers).

verses.text:
पैतृकं तु पिता द्रव्यम् अनवाप्तं यद् आप्नुयात् ।
न तत् पुत्रैर् भजेत् सार्धम् अ.कामः स्वयम् अर्जितम् ॥
                                    २०९ ॥
verses.english: But if a father recovers lost ancestral property, he shall not divide it, unless by his own will, with his sons, (for it is) self-acquired (property).

verses.text:
विभक्ताः सह जीवन्तो विभजेरन् पुनर् यदि ।
समस् तत्र विभागः स्याज् ज्यैष्ठ्यं तत्र न विद्यते ॥
                                    २१० ॥
verses.english: If brothers, (once) divided and living (again) together (as coparceners), make a second partition, the division shall in that case be equal; in such a case there is no right of primogeniture.

verses.text:
येषां ज्येष्ठः कनिष्ठो वा हीयेत-अंशप्रदानतः ।
म्रियेत-अन्यतरो वा-अपि तस्य भागो न लुप्यते ॥ २११
                                    ॥
verses.english: If the eldest or the youngest (brother) is deprived of his share, or if either of them dies, his share is not lost (to his immediate heirs).

verses.text:
सोदर्या विभजेरंस् तं समेत्य सहिताः समम् ।
भ्रातरो ये च संसृष्टा भागिन्यश् च स.नाभयः ॥ २१२
                                    ॥
verses.english: His uterine brothers, having assembled together, shall equally divide it, and those brothers who were reunited (with him) and the uterine sisters.

verses.text:
यो ज्येष्ठो विनिकुर्वीत लोभाद् भ्रातॄन् यवीयसः ।
सो ऽज्येष्ठः स्याद् अ.भागश् च नियन्तव्यश् च राजभिः ॥
                                    २१३ ॥
verses.english: An eldest brother who through avarice may defraud the younger ones, shall no (longer hold the position of) the eldest, shall not receive an (eldest son's additional) share, and shall be punished by the king.

verses.text:
सर्व एव विकर्मस्था न-अर्हन्ति भ्रातरो धनम् ।
न च-अ.दत्त्वा कनिष्ठेभ्यो ज्येष्ठः कुर्वीत यौतकम् ॥
                                    २१४ ॥
verses.english: All brothers who habitually commit forbidden acts, are unworthy of (a share of) the property, and the eldest shall not make (anything his) separate property without giving (an equivalent) to his younger brothers.

verses.text:
भ्रातॄणाम् अ.विभक्तानां यद्य् उत्थानं भवेत् सह ।
न पुत्रभागं विषमं पिता दद्यात् कथं चन ॥ २१५
                                    ॥
verses.english: If undivided brethren, (living with their father,) together make an exertion (for gain), the father shall on no account give to them unequal shares (on a division of the estate).

verses.text:
ऊर्ध्वं विभागात्-जातस् तु पित्र्यम् एव हरेद् धनम् ।
संसृष्टास् तेन वा ये स्युर् विभजेत स तैः सह ॥ २१६
                                    ॥
verses.english: But a son, born after partition, shall alone take the property of his father, or if any (of the other sons) be reunited with the (father), he shall share with them.

verses.text:
अन्.अपत्यस्य पुत्रस्य माता दायम् अवाप्नुयात् ।
मातर्य् अपि च वृत्तायां पितुर् माता हरेद् धनम् ॥ २१७
                                    ॥
verses.english: A mother shall obtain the inheritance of a son (who dies) without leaving issue, and, if the mother be dead, the paternal grandmother shall take the estate.

verses.text:
ऋणे धने च सर्वस्मिन् प्रविभक्ते यथाविधि ।
पश्चाद् दृश्येत यत् किं चित् तत् सर्वं समतां नयेत् ॥
                                    २१८ ॥
verses.english: And if, after all the debts and assets have been duly distributed according to the rule, any (property) be afterwards discovered, one must divide it equally.

verses.text:
वस्त्रं पत्रम् अलङ्कारं कृतान्नम् उदकं स्त्रियः ।
योगक्षेमं प्रचारं च न विभाज्यं प्रचक्षते ॥ २१९
                                    ॥
verses.english: A dress, a vehicle, ornaments, cooked food, water, and female (slaves), property destined for pious uses or sacrifices, and a pasture-ground, they declare to be indivisible.

verses.text:
अयम् उक्तो विभागो वः पुत्राणां च क्रियाविधिः ।
क्रमशः क्षेत्रजादीनां द्यूतधर्मं निबोधत ॥ २२०
                                    ॥
verses.english: The division (of the property) and the rules for allotting (shares) to the (several) sons, those begotten on a wife and the rest, in (due) order, have been thus declared to you; hear (now) the laws concerning gambling.

verses.text:
द्यूतं समाह्वयं च-एव राजा राष्ट्रात्-निवारयेत् ।
राजान्तकरणाव् एतौ द्वौ दोषौ पृथिवीक्षिताम् ॥ २२१ ॥
verses.english: Gambling and betting let the king exclude from his realm; those two vices cause the destruction of the kingdoms of princes.

verses.text:
प्रकाशम् एतत् तास्कर्यं यद् देवन.समाह्वयौ ।
तयोर् नित्यं प्रतीघाते नृपतिर् यत्नवान् भवेत् ॥ २२२
                                ॥
verses.english: Gambling and betting amount to open theft; the king shall always exert himself in suppressing both (of them).

verses.text:
अप्राणिभिर् यत् क्रियते तत्-लोके द्यूतम् उच्यते ।
प्राणिभिः क्रियते यस् तु स विज्ञेयः समाह्वयः ॥ २२३
                                ॥
verses.english: When inanimate (things) are used (for staking money on them), that is called among men gambling (dyuta), when animate beings are used (for the same purpose), one must know that to be betting (samahvaya).

verses.text:
द्यूतं समाह्वयं च-एव यः कुर्यात् कारयेत वा ।
तान् सर्वान् घातयेद् राजा शूद्रांश् च द्विजलिङ्गिनः ॥ २२४
                                ॥
verses.english: Let the king corporally punish all those (persons) who either gamble and bet or afford (an opportunity for it), likewise Sudras who assume the distinctive marks of twice-born (men).

verses.text:
कितवान् कुशीलवान् क्रूरान् पाषण्डस्थांश् च मानवान् ।
विकर्मस्थान् शौण्डिकांश् च क्षिप्रं निर्वासयेत् पुरात् ॥ २२५
                                ॥
verses.english: Gamblers, dancers and singers, cruel men, men belonging to an heretical sect, those following forbidden occupations, and sellers of spirituous liquor, let him instantly banish from his town.

verses.text:
एते राष्ट्रे वर्तमाना राज्ञः प्रछन्नतस्कराः ।
विकर्मक्रियया नित्यं बाधन्ते भद्रिकाः प्रजाः ॥ २२६
                                ॥
verses.english: If such (persons who are) secret thieves, dwell in the realm of a king, they constantly harass his good subjects by their forbidden practices.

verses.text:
द्यूतम् एतत् पुरा कल्पे दृष्टं वैरकरं महत् ।
तस्माद् द्यूतं न सेवेत हास्यार्थम् अपि बुद्धिमान् ॥ २२७
                                ॥
verses.english: In a former Kalpa this (vice of) gambling has been seen to cause great enmity; a wise man, therefore, should not practise it even for amusement.

verses.text:
प्रच्छन्नं वा प्रकाशं वा तत्-निषेवेत यो नरः ।
तस्य दण्डविकल्पः स्याद् यथा.इष्टं नृपतेस् तथा ॥ २२८
                                ॥
verses.english: On every man who addicts himself to that (vice) either secretly or openly, the king may inflict punishment according to his discretion.

verses.text:
क्षत्र.विश्.शूद्रयोनिस् तु दण्डं दातुम् अशक्नुवन् ।
आनृण्यं कर्मणा गच्छेद् विप्रो दद्यात्-शनैः शनैः ॥ २२९
                                ॥
verses.english: But a Kshatriya, a Vaisya, and a Sudra who are unable to pay a fine, shall discharge the debt by labour; a Brahmana shall pay it by installments.

verses.text:
स्त्री.बाल.उन्मत्त.वृद्धानां दरिद्राणां च रोगिणाम् ।
शिफा.विदल.रज्जु.आद्यैर् विदध्यात्-नृपतिर् दमम् ॥ २३०
                                ॥
verses.english: On women, infants, men of disordered mind, the poor and the sick, the king shall inflict punishment with a whip, a cane, or a rope and the like.

verses.text:
